description: This file implements a storage backend for a notes application, providing functions to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete notes stored in a JSON file with thread safety.

methods.name: _now_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ISO 8601 format.

methods.name: _ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures the directory for a given file path exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _get_storage_path
methods.description: Retrieves the storage file path from environment variable or default.

methods.name: _load_all
methods.description: Loads all notes data from the storage file, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: _save_all
methods.description: Saves all notes data to the storage file atomically.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns all notes sorted by ID.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with title and content, assigning a new ID.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and/or content by ID.
